summary: The change implements the contract pre-flight, workflow wiring, lint coverage and mypy fix, and host CI shows the CI workflow passing. However, one file outside the issue's explicitly named scope was modified.

findings.message: This file is not among the files named by the issue (scripts/pr_contract.py, .github/workflows/agent-review.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml, scripts/wait_for_ci.py). The edit is a functionally identical single-to-double-quote rewrite of the BODY printf and implements no acceptance criterion. Revert it so the diff contains only in-scope files, per REVIEW non-negotiable 4 ('Only the files the issue names are changed').
